config.label: A three
config.description: A three.ws API key (sk_live_… / sk_test_…) with the herald:announce scope, or an OAuth access token for the same account, carried as Authorization: Bearer. Required: an announcement is always delivered to the key owner's own sessions. Aliases: THREE_WS_TOKEN, THREE_WS_BEARER. Treat like a password.

config.label: Base URL of the three
config.description: Base URL of the three.ws API. Override only when self-hosting or targeting a preview deployment.

config.label: Per-request timeout in milliseconds for the announce call
config.description: Per-request timeout in milliseconds for the announce call.
